item.title: OpenAI Beefs Up ChatGPT’s Image Generation Model
item.description: The ChatGPT Images 2.0 model is here. Our testing shows it’s better at creating more detailed images and rendering text, but it still struggles with languages other than English.

item.title: Mozilla Used Anthropic’s Mythos to Find and Fix 271 Bugs in Firefox
item.description: The Firefox team doesn’t think emerging AI capabilities will upend cybersecurity long term, but they warn that software developers are likely in for a rocky transition.

item.title: Tim Cook’s Legacy Is Turning Apple Into a Subscription
item.description: The soon-to-exit Apple CEO went all in on services. Now, the incoming CEO, John Ternus, will need to embrace the AI era.

item.title: This Scammer Used an AI-Generated MAGA Girl to Grift ‘Super Dumb’ Men
item.description: A med student says he’s made thousands of dollars selling photos and videos of a young conservative woman he created using generative tools. He’s not alone.

item.title: A Humanoid Robot Set a Half-Marathon Record in China
item.description: An autonomous robot from the company Honor ran a half marathon in 50:26, beating the human record by 7 minutes.

item.title: Prego Has a Dinner-Conversation-Recording Device, Capisce?
item.description: The pasta-sauce company has partnered with the nonprofit StoryCorps on a device designed to record family conversations around the table and save them for all time.

item.title: Tech CEOs Think AI Will Let Them Be Everywhere at Once
item.description: Mark Zuckerberg and Jack Dorsey have different visions for how to use AI for management purposes, but both imagine a system of heightened control.

item.title: It Takes 2 Minutes to Hack the EU’s New Age-Verification App
item.description: Plus: Major data breaches at a gym chain and hotel giant, a disruptive DDoS attack against Bluesky, dubious ICE hires, and more.

item.title: Schematik Is ‘Cursor for Hardware.’ Anthropic Wants In
item.description: Schematik is a program that aims to help people vibe code for physical devices. Hopefully, it won’t blow anything up.

item.title: OpenAI Executive Kevin Weil Is Leaving the Company
item.description: The former Instagram VP is departing the ChatGPT-maker, which is folding the AI science application he led into Codex.
